title: Page 294
transc:
No 1
Horner n. y.
1230 P. M.  Wash Feb. 18. 1865.
for Capt Chap man Sixty six Cedar St frog
---- Send the glover & the nesmith to Beau
fort N C also send forty two thousand bushels
of corn & forty thousand of oats & five
hundred tons of hay ---- Send no more to
Port Royal or Save Anna until further orders ----
Report by teleg when the Ship Thurbold is ready
to sail for orders ---- By order torch QrMr
Gen Signed S L Brown Col Q M Dept


No 1  1230 Pm
Horner NY  Wash Feb 18
for fleet frog ---- all supplies for Kidnap's opal
not gone to sea shld be here after directed
to Bow fort hair bore with orders to transports
to discharge their car goes with all speed &
return north so as to be available for further service
if needed ---- This applies to both sale &
steam transports ---- vessels now in harbor shld be
notified of this change ---- ship to save annie
& Pt Rile only for local wants Sig Meigs
